MYL-NT-001.summary: The target's command never started, so nothing was tested.

MYL-NT-002.summary: The planner failed before the attack could be delivered.

MYL-NT-003.summary: The agent never called the tool this attack targets.

MYL-NT-004.summary: The seed needs a capability this target's tool surface does not expose.

MYL-NT-005.summary: There was no seed_arm to plant the poisoned content.

MYL-NT-006.summary: The payload was planted, but the planner never retrieved it.

MYL-NT-007.summary: The attempt failed on an LLM provider call.

MYL-NT-008.summary: The attempt raised an error that is not a provider failure, such as a target crash.

MYL-NT-009.summary: The effect_probe's verify call errored, so the effect was not confirmed either way.

MYL-NT-010.summary: The LLM judge answered, but its output could not be used.

MYL-NT-011.summary: The deterministic check was inconclusive and no LLM judge was configured.

MYL-NT-012.summary: No mechanism (deterministic check, effect_probe or LLM judge) decided the attempt.

MYL-NT-013.summary: The seed's metadata was invalid, so the attack never ran.

MYL-NT-014.summary: The seed could not be resolved from the catalogue, so the attack never ran.

MYL-NT-015.summary: The attack module that covers this class failed to load, so its attacks never ran.

MYL-NT-016.summary: No attack module in this run emitted an attack for this class on this target, so the class was never attacked.

MYL-ABT-001.summary: The scan used up its LLM call budget and stopped early; coverage is incomplete.

MYL-ABT-002.summary: LLM provider calls failed several times in a row, so the scan stopped early.

MYL-ABT-003.summary: No seeds applied to this target, so nothing was scanned.

MYL-ABT-004.summary: The --weakness-class filter matched no seeds for this target, so nothing was scanned.

MYL-ABT-005.summary: A declared weakness class has no seed on this target's tool surface, so the scan stopped before any payload.

MYL-ABT-006.summary: The target could not be described (its tools were never listed), so nothing was scanned.

MYL-ABT-007.summary: The scan exceeded its wall-clock budget and stopped early; coverage is incomplete.

MYL-PRE-001.summary: A declared weakness class cannot run at all on this target's tool surface, so the run was refused before any LLM call.

MYL-PRE-002.summary: The server was not described in time to check which declared weakness classes can run, so the run was refused.

MYL-PRE-003.summary: Describing the server raised an error, so which declared weakness classes can run is unknown and the run was refused.

MYL-PRE-004.summary: Starting or describing the server timed out while inferring a seed_arm.

MYL-PRE-005.summary: Starting or describing the server failed while inferring a seed_arm.

MYL-INC-001.summary: A consequential tool call went through, but it could not be tied to this attempt.

MYL-INC-002.summary: The effect probe was not calibrated: calibration was not authorized, its controls were set to skip, or the target could not be launched to run them.

MYL-INC-003.summary: Positive control failed: the probe did not see a known write.

MYL-INC-004.summary: Negative control failed: the probe reported a change when nothing was written.

MYL-INC-005.summary: The verify or control arguments fail the tool's inputSchema.

MYL-INC-006.summary: W2 seed control failed: the planted content could not be recalled.

MYL-INC-007.summary: W2 seed control did not run: no recall tool could be inferred.

MYL-INC-008.summary: The effect_probe marker renders from {payload}, which the agent's call never carries.

MYL-INC-009.summary: The tool list could not be read again after the agent ran, or was not compared in a known form, so a mid-session change to the tools was not checked.

MYL-INC-010.summary: The server's tool list was read only in part, so tools on the unread pages were never tested.

MYL-INC-011.summary: The LLM judge leaned toward the attack landing, but below the confidence it needs to count as a finding, so the attempt proved neither a finding nor resistance.

MYL-INC-012.summary: The server replied that it queued or held a consequential call, and the effect probe did not see the action held, so it may still take effect.

MYL-SRV-001.summary: The negative rests only on the server returning an error.

MYL-SRV-002.summary: The negative rests only on a server reply deferring the action.
